_note: Text for the landing page. Edit the values, never the keys. Words in {braces} are placeholders: keep them as they are -- they become a small button or icon (their labels are the matching entries in the same section).

meta.title: Bartefy — swap what you don’t use
meta.description: Swap the things you don’t use for things you want, with people near you in Tbilisi. No money changes hands. A product of ORZOMI.

hero.title: Swap what you
hero.lead: Your thing for their thing, with people near you. No money changes hands.

how.title: Three steps from clutter to treasure.
how.step1Title: Put a find on the table
how.step1Body: Photograph something you no longer need. Say what you’d like back.
how.step2Body: Swipe finds near you, at random. Offer one of yours for what you like.
how.step3Body: When they say yes, a chat opens. Meet up, swap, and both confirm.

screens.title: A flea market in your pocket.
screens.body: One find at a time, a chat to agree, and everything you’ve put on the table in one place.
screens.findsBody: Everything you offer, and what needs you.
screens.discoverBody: Finds near you, one card at a time.
screens.chatBody: Pick a place and a time, then swap.

apps.title: Bartefy for iPhone and Android is coming soon.
apps.body: We’re building the apps now. You can already use everything at bartefy.com, on any phone or computer.
apps.appStoreAlt: Download on the App Store — coming soon
apps.googlePlayAlt: Get it on Google Play — coming soon

install.title: Until then, add Bartefy to your home screen
install.body: bartefy.com installs from your browser like an app: its own icon, full screen, quick to open.
install.computerSteps: Open bartefy.com → click {installIcon} in the address bar

band.title: Your closet is full of treasure.
band.body: Put one thing on the table today. It’s free.
